plugins.name: vstack
plugins.description: Visual Stack — visual-first delivery for Claude Code: plan, design, and build software on artifacts you operate, not documents you read. go — from any conversation, work out where the stack can pick up and help. start — set up a project on a multi-step visual form: from the Cavalry template, as a specs-and-design-only workspace, or by recording an existing codebase. wireframe — build a UI wireframe and comment directly on it in a review workspace, or point the same workspace at an app that is already running and comment on the real screens. spec — a drill-down spec tree the user prunes and annotates, exported as plain markdown. user-story-map — plan releases on an interactive drag-and-drop story map. phase-preview — see a signed-off mockup at each release phase. phase-build — plan a phase on a visual board, then watch it build with live per-node progress. Tool-agnostic: plain files in and out, safe beside speckit or any other tooling.
